# How much of your business vehicle can you deduct this year, and which method wins?

> Enter the vehicle price, class and business-use percentage and see the first-year deduction and tax saved under regular MACRS, 100% bonus depreciation and Section 179, with the car luxury-auto caps and the 6,000 lb SUV cap applied, plus standard mileage. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
